coverage.summary: Applies to landlords generally. The only available source, a secondary law-firm alert, describes the Rockville provision in one line. It states no unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or landlord-size limits and no exemptions.

evidence.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using algorithmic devices and shared competitor information to set rent, fees, or other rental terms.

result.notes: DX06 gives Rockville a single summary-table row with no coverage limits or exemptions, so all specific coverage fields remain null. The 16-or-more-units owner condition in the table belongs to Portland, OR, not Rockville. The pending Montgomery County, MD measure is a different jurisdiction. Verify coverage against the official Rockville City Code § 18-148.
